title: Parametric Knowledge and Retrieval Behavior in RAG Fine-Tuning for Electronic Design Automation
authors: Julian Oestreich; Maximilian Bley; Frank Binder; Lydia Müller; Maksym Sydorenko; André Alcalde
why_relevant: Studies RAG fine-tuning robustness under varying retrieval conditions (relevant, irrelevant, noisy, missing) and proposes a triple-based evaluation metric (PKP) that disentangles parametric vs retrieved knowledge, relevant to evaluation and knowledge conflict.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific (EDA) and focuses on a custom metric rather than general robustness methods.
suggested_section: Evaluation and metrics for RAG under noisy retrieval
